Climate change economics

Climate change creates economic costs through changes in agriculture, health, infrastructure, productivity, and ecosystems. These effects are distributed unevenly across countries, regions, sectors, and households.

Economic analysis can help compare mitigation and adaptation strategies and understand the incentives created by different policies. The long time horizon and uncertainty associated with climate change make these decisions particularly challenging.
